You are an adversarial verifier for a proposed STRUCTURAL refactor in the andesim repo at /home/nick/work/andesim.
READ-ONLY: do not edit, build, or run anything. Use Read/Grep/Glob only.

Claim (from reviewer driver-run):
- file: driver/process.cpp:49
- category: dead-code
- title: spawn_inherit's stdin_from_devnull parameter is never true - the /dev/null branch is dead
- detail: spawn_inherit (process.cpp:48-68, anonymous namespace, so no external callers) takes bool stdin_from_devnull and, when true, redirects the child's stdin from /dev/null (lines 56-62). Its only two callers both pass false: exec_passthrough (line 154, /*stdin_from_devnull=*/false) and fork_background (line 158, same). Grep over driver/ confirms no other call site. The parameter and its open/dup2 branch are unreachable; the header comment (process.cpp:42-47) even documents both users as 'stdin inherited'.
- claimed safety: Deleting the parameter and the if-block removes only never-executed code; both call sites already take the false path, so child processes get identical fd setups.

Try to REFUTE it. For dead-code: grep the WHOLE repo (and the demo suite at /home/nick/work/andesim-demo, and consider that vsim lives in a separate repo /home/nick/work/vsim_andesim - grep there too if the symbol could cross repos) for references. For duplication: read both sites fully and check they really are behavior-identical. For stale-doc: read the doc AND the code it describes. For bug-report: check whether the behavior is actually wrong vs intended. If the change could alter ANY observable behavior (output text, exit codes, file layout, test expectations), verdict RISKY with the exact risk. If the claim is wrong, REJECTED. Only CONFIRMED when you verified the evidence yourself.

1	// Subprocess helpers for andesim.
2	//
3	// run_process spawns a child, captures its stdout, and kills it after a
4	// timeout -- the primitive the engine registry uses to ask `<bin> --describe`
5	// and the plan executor (F6) uses to run orchestrated legs. F5 extends this
6	// file with exec_passthrough (inherit stdio, no timeout) for fast/cycle.
7	#ifndef ANDESIM_PROCESS_HPP
8	#define ANDESIM_PROCESS_HPP
9	
10	#include <functional>
11	#include <string>
12	#include <string_view>
13	#include <vector>
14	
15	namespace andes_sim {
16	
17	struct RunResult {
18	  int rc = -1;                // child exit status, or -1 if killed/abnormal
19	  std::string out;            // captured stdout
20	  bool timed_out = false;     // killed because it exceeded the timeout
21	  bool spawn_failed = false;  // pipe/fork failed before the child ran
22	};
23	
24	// Run argv (argv[0] resolved via PATH), capturing stdout. The child's stdin
25	// is redirected to /dev/null; stderr too, unless relay_stderr is set, in
26	// which case the child inherits OUR stderr and its diagnostics stream live
27	// (used to surface the legs' leveled logs at --log-level <= debug). If the
28	// child runs longer than timeout_ms it is SIGKILLed and timed_out is set.
29	RunResult run_process(const std::vector<std::string>& argv, int timeout_ms,
30	                      bool relay_stderr = false);
31	
32	// Run argv to completion with the child INHERITING all three std streams
33	// (stdin, stdout, stderr) -- the transparent-passthrough mechanism behind
34	// `run --mode fast|cycle`: the engine reads/writes the terminal directly,
35	// so an interactive gdbstub or semihosting console works unchanged. No chdir,
36	// no capture, no timeout. Returns the child's exit code, 128+signal if it was
37	// signalled, or -1 on spawn failure / empty argv.
38	int exec_passthrough(const std::vector<std::string>& argv);
39	
40	// Fork a child that execs argv with inherited stdio and return immediately
41	// without waiting. Used by `run --mode cycle --gdb` to launch vsim in the
42	// background before exec-ing ICEman in the foreground. Returns the child pid
43	// on success, -1 on empty argv or fork failure.
44	int fork_background(const std::vector<std::string>& argv);
45	
46	// Run argv with BOTH stdout and stderr captured (separate pipes) and stdin
47	// inherited, streaming each complete line to `on_line(stream, line)` as it
48	// arrives -- stream is 1 (stdout) or 2 (stderr), line excludes the trailing
49	// newline. The callback owns presentation (it decides what to write to the real
50	// streams), so this is the filtered counterpart to exec_passthrough: same "run
51	// to completion, no timeout, propagate exit code" contract, but the parent sees
52	// every line. A final unterminated line is delivered too. Returns the child's
53	// exit code, 128+signal if signalled, or -1 on spawn failure / empty argv.
54	int run_line_filtered(
55	    const std::vector<std::string>& argv,
56	    const std::function<void(int stream, std::string_view line)>& on_line);
57	
58	}  // namespace andes_sim
59	
60	#endif  // ANDESIM_PROCESS_HPP
61

input.reason: Verified: spawn_inherit is anonymous-namespace-local to driver/process.cpp (not in process.hpp, no linkage), and its only two callers (exec_passthrough line 154, fork_background line 158) both pass stdin_from_devnull=false, so the /dev/null branch (lines 56-62) is unreachable. Grep across the whole andesim repo, /home/nick/work/andesim-demo, and /home/nick/work/vsim_andesim found no other references. Git history confirms the residue: commit 4dbfe7e (in HEAD's history) deleted run_inherit - the only caller that ever passed true - and the cwd param, leaving stdin_from_devnull dead. The only counter-evidence found is the stale .claude/worktrees/f6-last-mile worktree (branch diverged by 226/152 commits) which still holds the pre-4dbfe7e variant with a true caller; that separate branch's copy already differs from HEAD and does not make the current-branch code live. Removing the parameter and block leaves both call sites with byte-identical child fd setups (stdin inherited), matching the process.hpp contract; no output, exit-code, or test-expectation change.
